d:
Ryou confesses his love to Yuko, but she turns out to be a five-breasted futanari with a thing for crossdressing boys. What could go wrong?

Chapters 1 & 2 are digital, 3 is scanned. Translated to English by Moosh.

Chapter 1 part 2 has been moved to the end as Chapter 4 to keep with the flow of the story.
n: [Doujinshi] [Circle B.C.A. (Tsuno)] Connect Androgynous to Boy 1-3 [English][Moosh][Digital & Scan]
